deferredCredentials.cardNotAvailableYetW.translation: Utfärdaren av kortet har sagt att du kan kolla igen den {0}.

comments: Label shown above optional extra description

paso.refusal.externalResourceVerificatio.message: The payee logo of this payment could not be verified.
comments: Shown when a PaSO external resource fails its integrity check

paso.refusal.payloadDoesNotConform.message: The payment details are not valid, so this payment cannot be authorized.
comments: Shown when a PaSO payload does not conform to its rulebook
paso.refusal.payloadDoesNotConform.translation: Betalningsuppgifterna är ogiltiga, så den här betalningen kan inte godkännas.

paso.refusal.invalidCredentialMetadata.message: The payment details of your card could not be verified. Try again later.
comments: Shown when the signed PaSO credential metadata is missing or fails verification
paso.refusal.invalidCredentialMetadata.translation: Betalningsuppgifterna för ditt kort kunde inte verifieras. Försök igen senare.

dcApi.nothingRequested.message: The request asks for no documents.

notifications.errorBoundary.description.message: The request could not be handled. You can safely close this and try again.
comments: Body text shown when a received request could not be handled at all
notifications.errorBoundary.description.translation: Förfrågan kunde inte hanteras. Du kan tryggt stänga detta och försöka igen.

comments: Reason passed to the OS when the user declines; not shown to the user

invalidTxCode.message.message: The transaction code you entered is incorrect. Ask the issuer to generate a new QR-code and try again.
comments: Body explaining that the transaction code was wrong and how to recover
invalidTxCode.message.translation: Transaktionskoden du angav är felaktig. Be utgivaren att generera en ny QR-kod och försök igen.

cardLifecycle.limitedByDate.validityPeri.message: The validity period of this card is from {0} until {1}.
cardLifecycle.limitedByDate.validityPeri.translation: Detta korts giltighetsperiod är från {0} till {1}.

comments: Heading shown when a list, such as the cards or the activity, is still empty

onboardingIdCardRequestedAttributes.desc.message: These {0} attributes will be read from your eID card.
comments: Text explaining how many attributes will be read from the eID card
onboardingIdCardRequestedAttributes.desc.translation: Dessa {0} uppgifter kommer att läsas från ditt eID-kort.

qrScanner.permissionDescription.message: This allows the app to scan QR codes that include credentials or data requests.
comments: Description explaining why camera permission is needed
qrScanner.permissionDescription.translation: Detta gör att appen kan skanna QR-koder som innehåller kort eller dataförfrågningar.

offlineQr.allowBluetoothAccessDescriptio.message: This allows the app to share with a QR code.
offlineQr.allowBluetoothAccessDescriptio.translation: Detta gör det möjligt för appen att dela med en QR-kod.

paradymWallet.about.description.message: This app was created by Animo Solutions as a companion app for Paradym. All code is available under Apache 2.0.
comments: About screen description text for the Paradym wallet
paradymWallet.about.description.translation: Denna app skapades av Animo Solutions som en kompletterande app för Paradym. All kod är tillgänglig under Apache 2.0.

biometricsRequiredSlide.description.message: This card can only be used after you confirm it is you with your face or fingerprint. Set up biometrics in the settings of your device, then return to the wallet to continue.
comments: Explains that biometrics must be set up on the device before this card can be added
biometricsRequiredSlide.description.translation: Det här kortet kan bara användas efter att du har bekräftat att det är du med ditt ansikte eller fingeravtryck. Konfigurera biometri i enhetens inställningar och gå sedan tillbaka till plånboken för att fortsätta.

cardLifecycle.limitedByDate.expiresIn.translation: Detta kort går ut om {expiryDaysString}, den {0}.

cardLifecycle.batch.sheetDescription.message: This card requires periodic validation using an internet connection. When usage is low you will be notified.
cardLifecycle.batch.sheetDescription.translation: Detta kort kräver regelbunden validering med internetanslutning. Du får en avisering när användningen är låg.

cardLifecycle.limitedByDate.activeIn.message: This card will be active in {activeDaysString}, on {0}.
cardLifecycle.limitedByDate.activeIn.translation: Detta kort blir aktivt om {activeDaysString}, den {0}.

common.featureNotSupported.message: This feature is not supported in this version of the app.
comments: Shown when a feature that is not supported is accessed
common.featureNotSupported.translation: Denna funktion stöds inte i denna version av appen.

comments: Title shown for offline message

pidSetup.idCardPin.subtitle.message: This is required to read data from your card.
pidSetup.idCardPin.subtitle.translation: Detta krävs för att läsa data från ditt kort.

onboardingWelcome.description.message: This is your digital wallet. With it, you can store and share information about yourself.
comments: Intro paragraph on the welcome screen
onboardingWelcome.description.translation: Det här är din digitala plånbok. Med den kan du lagra och dela information om dig själv.

comments: Heading introducing the wallet, in onboarding and on the empty wallet screen

verifyPartySlide.overAskingConfirmationD.message: This organization asks for more than it registered. You can review the request before anything is shared.
comments: Shown in the sheet that asks to confirm continuing with a request that asks for more than the organization registered, when the name of the organization is unknown
verifyPartySlide.overAskingConfirmationD.translation: Den här organisationen begär mer än den har registrerat. Du kan granska begäran innan något delas.

common.overAskingWarningUnknownOrganizat.message: This organization is not authorized to ask for the information in the request. Only continue if you trust it
comments: Warning shown when a request asks for more data than the organization registered to ask for, when the name of the organization is unknown
common.overAskingWarningUnknownOrganizat.translation: Den här organisationen får inte begära informationen i den här begäran. Fortsätt bara om du litar på den

paso.refusal.noSupportedLocale.message: This payment cannot be shown in a language you understand.
comments: Shown when no locale produces a complete match for the PaSO transaction data
paso.refusal.noSupportedLocale.translation: Den här betalningen kan inte visas på ett språk du förstår.

paso.refusal.tooComplex.message: This payment request is more complex than this wallet can authorize.
comments: Shown when a PaSO payment request needs features the wallet does not support
paso.refusal.tooComplex.translation: Den här betalningsbegäran är mer komplex än vad den här plånboken kan godkänna.

paso.refusal.requestNotSigned.message: This payment request is not signed, so it cannot be authorized.
comments: Shown when a PaSO payment request arrives without a signature
paso.refusal.requestNotSigned.translation: Den här betalningsbegäran är inte signerad och kan därför inte godkännas.

paso.refusal.unsupported.message: This payment uses features this wallet does not support yet.
comments: Shown when a PaSO payment request uses an unsupported type or algorithm
paso.refusal.unsupported.translation: Den här betalningen använder funktioner som den här plånboken inte stöder ännu.

onboarding.pin.subtitle.message: This PIN secures your identity wallet. You enter it every time you share data.
comments: Explanation of the PIN purpose in onboarding
onboarding.pin.subtitle.translation: Denna PIN-kod säkrar din identitetsplånbok. Du anger den varje gång du delar data.

dcApi.requestFailed.message: This request could not be read. Ask the verifier to make a new request and try again.
comments: Shown when the request could not be read, before the user was asked to approve anything
dcApi.requestFailed.translation: Den här förfrågan kunde inte läsas. Be verifieraren skicka en ny förfrågan och försök igen.

common.archiveCardDescription.message: This will make {name} unusable and delete it from your wallet.
comments: Description in confirmation dialog explaining card archiving
common.archiveCardDescription.translation: Detta gör {name} oanvändbart och tar bort det från din plånbok.

pidSetup.enableBiometrics.subtitle.message: To continue, make sure your device has biometric protection enabled, and that Paradym Wallet is allowed to use biometrics.
pidSetup.enableBiometrics.subtitle.translation: För att fortsätta, se till att din enhet har biometriskt skydd aktiverat och att Paradym Wallet får använda biometri.

credentialCardSlide.subtitle.pin.message: To receive this card from {issuerName}, you need to enter a PIN.
comments: Subtitle shown when entering a PIN is required to receive the credential
credentialCardSlide.subtitle.pin.translation: För att ta emot detta kort från {issuerName} behöver du ange en PIN-kod.

credentialCardSlide.subtitle.presentatio.message: To receive this card from {issuerName}, you need to share cards from your wallet.
comments: Subtitle shown when presentation of other credentials is required
credentialCardSlide.subtitle.presentatio.translation: För att ta emot detta kort från {issuerName} behöver du dela kort från din plånbok.

txCodeSlide.instructions.message: To receive this card you need to enter a transaction code. This code has been provided to you by the issuer.
comments: Instructions explaining why the user must enter a transaction code
txCodeSlide.instructions.translation: För att ta emot detta kort behöver du ange en transaktionskod. Denna kod har tillhandahållits av utfärdaren.

authCodeFlowSlide.description.message: To receive this card, you need to authorize with your account. You will now be redirected to the issuer's website.
comments: Explanation for why user is redirected to external site
authCodeFlowSlide.description.translation: För att ta emot detta kort behöver du godkänna med ditt konto. Du kommer nu att omdirigeras till utfärdarens webbplats.

comments: Heading shown when the user has entered too many incorrect PINs
Label for the input field where the user types the transaction code
The United Nations distinguishing sign of an mDL
Shown when fetching an invitation from a URL fails
Heading shown above a list of requested cards the user does not have

dcApi.unlockSubtitle.message: Unlock to see what {origin} is asking for
comments: Shown while the wallet is locked, before it can say what is being asked for
dcApi.unlockSubtitle.translation: Lås upp för att se vad {origin} begär

comments: Button label for unlocking the ID card using biometrics
Shown when scanned QR code has unsupported URL prefix
qrScan.unsupportedQrCode.translation: QR-kod stöds inte. Försök med en annan.

qrScanner.instructionHeading.message: Use the camera to scan a QR code
comments: Instruction heading for scanning a QR code
qrScanner.instructionHeading.translation: Använd kameran för att skanna en QR-kod

pinSlide.description.message: Use your app PIN code to confirm the request.
comments: Supporting text explaining why PIN is needed
pinSlide.description.translation: Använd din app-PIN-kod för att bekräfta förfrågan.

onboardingIntroduction.step2.description.message: Use your ID card PIN to retrieve your identity information.
comments: Description of the second onboarding step about reading identity info
onboardingIntroduction.step2.description.translation: Använd din ID-korts PIN-kod för att hämta din identitetsinformation.

comments: The time ƒrom which a credential is valid
The value of a driving privilege in an mDL
The vehicle category code of an mDL
Heading shown when user is about to authenticate
Description text for the attributes button
Heading above the wallet section

pidSetup.idCardVerify.Subtitle.message: We need your biometrics to verify your identity.
pidSetup.idCardVerify.Subtitle.translation: Vi behöver din biometri för att verifiera din identitet.

comments: Welcome title in wallet screen
Title for second slide of wallet onboarding
Generic yes/confirm action label
Confirm button text for archiving a card
Confirm button text for deleting a pending card
Explanation that the user is about to sign a document
signing.description.translation: Du är på väg att signera <0>{documentName}</0>.

connection.successParagraph.message:
You can now receive notifications from 
<0>{name}</0>
comments: Explains that the user can now receive notifications from the connected issuer
connection.successParagraph.translation:
Du kan nu ta emot aviseringar från 
<0>{name}</0>

nfcScanner.complete.description.message: You can now remove your eID card.
comments: Description when NFC scan completed successfully
nfcScanner.complete.description.translation: Du kan nu ta bort ditt eID-kort.

presentationSuccess.returnHint.message: You can now return to the previous app.
comments: Instruction shown when a presentation request is completed, declined or failed
presentationSuccess.returnHint.translation: Du kan nu gå tillbaka till föregående app.

sharing.failed.missingCredentials.message: You did not have the required credentials to disclose.
comments: Displayed when the user tries to share but lacks the needed credentials
sharing.failed.missingCredentials.translation: Du hade inte de kort som krävdes för att dela.

common.someRequestedCardsMissingDescript.message: You don't have all of the requested cards.
comments: Description when the user has some but not all requested cards
common.someRequestedCardsMissingDescript.translation: Du har inte alla begärda kort.

common.noNotificationsDescription.message: You don't have any notifications at the moment.
comments: Message shown when the user has no notifications
common.noNotificationsDescription.translation: Du har inga aviseringar just nu.

common.noRequestedCardsDescription.message: You don't have the requested card(s).
comments: Description when the user has none of the requested cards
common.noRequestedCardsDescription.translation: Du har inte de begärda korten.

common.missingCardsWarning.message: You don't have the required cards
comments: Shown above the close button when the user lacks the required credentials
common.missingCardsWarning.translation: Du har inte de kort som krävs

pinLocked.description.message: You have entered an incorrect PIN. The wallet was locked, please reset it to set a new PIN and continue.
comments: Descriptive text explaining that the wallet is locked and must be reset
pinLocked.description.translation: Du har angett en felaktig PIN-kod. Plånboken har låsts, återställ den för att sätta en ny PIN-kod och fortsätta.

activity.receivedSingle.message: You have received the following card from {0}.
comments: Shown in activity detail when one credential has been received
activity.receivedSingle.translation: Du har tagit emot följande kort från {0}.

activity.receivedMultiple.message: You have received the following cards from {0}.
comments: Shown in activity detail when multiple credentials have been received
activity.receivedMultiple.translation: Du har tagit emot följande kort från {0}.

onboardingIntroduction.reminder.message: You'll need your eID card to setup the wallet
comments: Reminder shown before user continues onboarding
onboardingIntroduction.reminder.translation: Du behöver ditt eID-kort för att ställa in plånboken

comments: Heading shown when the user has no notifications

dcApi.shareFailed.message: Your card could not be shared. Ask the verifier to make a new request and try again.
comments: Shown when the card could not be shared, after the user already approved the request
dcApi.shareFailed.translation: Ditt kort kunde inte delas. Be verifieraren skicka en ny förfrågan och försök igen.

common.missingAttributesWarning.message: Your cards are missing required attributes
comments: Shown above the close button when the user has the required cards, but they lack requested attributes
common.missingAttributesWarning.translation: Dina kort saknar uppgifter som krävs

common.unmetAttributesWarning.message: Your cards are missing required attributes or don't have the requested values
comments: Shown above the close button when the user has the required cards, but they lack requested attributes and hold others with a value the request does not accept
common.unmetAttributesWarning.translation: Dina kort saknar uppgifter som krävs eller har inte de begärda värdena

receiveCredential.deferredCredentialPara.message: Your cards are not yet ready. We will check once in a while in the background and fetch the cards once they're ready.
receiveCredential.deferredCredentialPara.translation: Dina kort är inte klara ännu. Vi kollar med jämna mellanrum i bakgrunden och hämtar dem så snart de är redo.

common.mismatchedAttributesWarning.message: Your cards don't have the requested values
comments: Shown above the close button when the user has the required cards, but they hold requested attributes with a value the request does not accept
common.mismatchedAttributesWarning.translation: Dina kort har inte de begärda värdena

cardLifecycle.active.sheetDescription.message: Your credentials may expire or require an active internet connection to validate.
cardLifecycle.active.sheetDescription.translation: Dina kort kan gå ut eller kräva en aktiv internetanslutning för validering.

pidSetup.dataProtection.subtitle.message: Your data is secured with a PIN and biometrics. Each time you share data, we confirm your identity.
pidSetup.dataProtection.subtitle.translation: Dina uppgifter är säkrade med PIN-kod och biometri. Varje gång du delar data bekräftar vi din identitet.

pidSetup.idCardComplete.subtitle.message: Your information has been retrieved from your eID card.
pidSetup.idCardComplete.subtitle.translation: Din information har hämtats från ditt eID-kort.

presentationSuccess.messageWithVerifier.message: Your information has been shared with <0>{verifierName}</0>.
comments: Shown after credentials are shared with a specific verifier
Shown after credentials are shared (no verifier name)

paso.refusal.credentialOnlyForPayments.message: Your payment card can only be used to authorize a payment, and this request is not one.
comments: Shown when a request asks for a PaSO payment card without a payment for it to authorize
paso.refusal.credentialOnlyForPayments.translation: Ditt betalkort kan bara användas för att godkänna en betalning, och den här begäran är ingen betalning.

authenticate.pinRequiredToast.message: Your PIN is required to unlock the app
authenticate.pinRequiredToast.translation: Din PIN-kod krävs för att låsa upp appen
